name: google-ai-mcp
description: FastMCP gateway for Google AI: Gemini 3.8 / 4 Argon chat, Nano Banana 2.1 images, Veo 3.1 + Omni 1.1 video, Lyria 3.5 music, Gemini 3.8 TTS, embeddings, LeWM world-model bridge

google_api_key.title: Google AI API Key
google_api_key.description: API key from Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com)

google_cloud_project.title: Google Cloud Project ID
google_cloud_project.description: Required for Veo 3.1 video (Vertex AI). Optional fallback for Lyria when no API key is set.

genie_model_id.title: Genie 4 model ID (early access)
genie_model_id.description: Leave empty until Genie 4 API access is granted; run google_ai_genie(operation='probe') to find the id.

lewm_api_url.title: LeWM MCP URL
lewm_api_url.description: Local lewm-mcp HTTP endpoint for world-model bridge

tools.name: google_ai_chat
tools.description: Gemini 3.8 Flash / Gemini 4 Argon / Gemma 4 chat and list_models

tools.name: google_ai_omni
tools.description: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash video generation and editing

tools.name: google_ai_speech
tools.description: One-shot Gemini 3.8 TTS (not Live; use speech-mcp for streaming)

tools.name: google_ai_genie
tools.description: Genie 4 world model scaffold (waitlist): status, probe, experimental generate

tools.name: google_ai_status
tools.description: Health check all Google AI services

tools.name: show_google_ai_status_card
tools.description: Prefab dashboard card for service status
